svg.title: Final results on the sealed test set
svg.desc: Mean improvement with 95% confidence intervals. score, test (primary): +22.1 (17.5 to 26.5); score, mirrored test: +24.6 (19.8 to 29.6); rules only, no judge: +17.1 (13.6 to 20.5); first move right (% points): +32.1 (25.0 to 39.2); second judge (80 puzzles): +19.4 (11.8 to 27.1); A/A: same config twice: +0.4 (-4.9 to 5.8); mirror minus original, final: +2.3 (-1.5 to 6.3); mirror minus original, bare: -0.2 (-3.2 to 2.7); calc tool vs final, test: +25.1 (20.7 to 29.6).

g.text: after the climb, one look at test (exploratory)
